name: Techno Industries
overview: Techno Industries is an ISO-certified manufacturer specializing in value-added corrugated packaging for local and international markets. Part of Techno Group, the company combines technical expertise, manufacturing technology and food-grade certified materials to produce packaging with durability, structural integrity and product presentation in mind.
vision: To be the region’s most trusted innovator in value-added corrugated packaging, delivering safe, durable, and sustainable solutions that strengthen brands and protect products.
